title: CS50’s Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python

learning.conditions: OpenCourseWare learning is free. Recognition needs edX registration and the CS50 submission/Gradebook workflow; paid edX verification is optional. Follow course prerequisites and academic honesty rules. Prerequisite: CS50x or at least one year of experience with Python.

outcomes.name: Free CS50 Certificate — CS50’s Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python
outcomes.requirements: Earn at least 70% on each required project, following academic honesty rules. Register with edX and enable/link the CS50 Gradebook; request the free certificate from the Gradebook after completion using GitHub sign-in. The FAQ currently sets the course deadline to 30 June 2027; request/download the certificate before that deadline. This proposal covers the free CS50 certificate, not paid edX verification, professional credentials or academic credit.

evidence.review_note: The specific course provides its materials free to non-Harvard learners; account setup is needed for submission/recognition.
Course-specific certificate page explicitly makes the free certificate available after graded completion.
Explicitly free issuer certificate; paid edX verification is a separate option.
The threshold applies to each required project, not to completing only 70% of the work.
Current FAQ requires registration even for the free certificate; also describes Gradebook, GitHub redemption and the 30 June 2027 deadline.
CS50x or at least one year of experience with Python.
